note: Accepted (known, triaged) dependency advisories. Every entry carries the reason it is accepted rather than fixed (validated by scripts/lib/reason_validator.ts; a reason-less entry is RED). A NEW advisory fails CI; a vanished one only prints a nudge (see scripts/ci/audit.ts). Regenerate with `bun run scripts/ci/audit.ts --update`; accepting an advisory the baseline does not hold (compared by KEY, so a swap is a regression; a missing baseline makes every advisory new; a conflicted one is refused, never compared against nothing) REFUSES without `--allow-regression --reason "<text>"`, and the reason is written here, per entry.

..title: adm-zip: Crafted ZIP file triggers 4GB memory allocation
..reason: Transitive only, through the exact @huggingface/transformers pin's onnxruntime-node; no engine code hands adm-zip a ZIP, it unpacks the runtime's own binary at install. A fixed release is published upstream and the bump is tracked under P1-23 (GATE-53), so this acceptance is a decision to ship it until that bump lands, not a claim that no fix exists.

..title: jsdiff has a Denial of Service vulnerability in parsePatch and applyPatch
..reason: Transitive only, through mocha, a devDependency: the diff library is loaded by the browser-client test runner and never by the engine, and devDependencies are excluded from the production image and from the update quarantine. A fixed release is published upstream and the bump is tracked under P1-23 (GATE-53).
